comparison.objective: Recover a carrier from under a retaining lip without tipping samples; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-arm shared-load extraction differs from stabilizing a component while engaging a hex key and adjusting and locking a collar.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier reaches a stand with four samples upright and limited tilt; candidate requires repeated non-bottoming impacts and no adjustment drift. Final placement tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Both use two arms, but the tested abilities and failure modes are materially different.
